title: Honey Drizzled Hazy Toast Flatbread
description: A funky, snappy Mediterranean dish featuring a gluten-free flatbread with ground nutmeg and drizzled honey.

ingredients.name: fresh herbs (optional)
ingredients.notes: like parsley or mint for garnish

instructions: Mix gluten-free flour, water, olive oil, salt, and ground nutmeg in a bowl.
Knead dough until smooth. Cover and let rest for 10 minutes.
Divide dough into equal parts and roll out each part to about 1/4 inch thickness.
Preheat oven to 250C (475F). Bake flatbread on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper for 3-5 minutes or until lightly golden brown.
Drizzle honey over warm flatbread while still warm, garnish with fresh herbs if using.
